# ReXGlue PPC instruction tests on the PS Vita (ARMv7) and, for validation of
# the harness itself, on the desktop host.
#
# Inputs: the test sources generated by `rexglue recompile-tests` during the
# desktop ppc_tests build (PPC_GEN_DIR). They are compiled unchanged with the
# 32-bit memory model (REX_GUEST_SOFT_MMU + REX_GUEST_SPLIT_U64); only the
# Catch2 case file is converted to a plain runner (tools/convert_cases.py).
#
# Vita:  cmake -G Ninja -S vita/ppc_tests -B vita/ppc_tests/build-vita \
#          -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=%VITASDK%/share/vita.toolchain.cmake
# Host:  cmake -G Ninja -S vita/ppc_tests -B vita/ppc_tests/build-host \
#          -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

if(DEFINED ENV{VITASDK} AND CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE MATCHES "vita")
  set(REX_VITA_BUILD ON)
endif()

project(rexglue_ppc_tests_vita CXX C)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

set(REXGLUE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../rexglue" CACHE PATH "ReXGlue checkout")
set(PPC_GEN_DIR "${REXGLUE_DIR}/out/build/win-amd64/tests/ppc/generated"
    CACHE PATH "Directory with ppc_test_functions.cpp / ppc_test_cases.cpp / ppc_config.h")
find_program(PYTHON_EXE NAMES python3 python REQUIRED)

set(VITA_CASES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/vita_test_cases.cpp")
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT ${VITA_CASES}
  COMMAND ${PYTHON_EXE} -I ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tools/convert_cases.py
          ${PPC_GEN_DIR}/ppc_test_cases.cpp ${VITA_CASES}
  DEPENDS ${PPC_GEN_DIR}/ppc_test_cases.cpp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tools/convert_cases.py
  COMMENT "Converting Catch2 test cases for the Vita runner"
  VERBATIM)

add_executable(ppc_tests_vita
  src/harness.cpp
  ${PPC_GEN_DIR}/ppc_test_functions.cpp
  ${VITA_CASES})

# Shims first so they shadow the desktop-runtime headers.
target_include_directories(ppc_tests_vita BEFORE PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/shim
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src
  ${PPC_GEN_DIR}
  ${REXGLUE_DIR}/include
  ${REXGLUE_DIR}/thirdparty/simde)

target_compile_definitions(ppc_tests_vita PRIVATE REX_GUEST_SOFT_MMU REX_GUEST_SPLIT_U64)
# -fwrapv: guest integer arithmetic wraps like the PPC; avoids signed-overflow UB.
target_compile_options(ppc_tests_vita PRIVATE -fwrapv -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-unused-variable)

if(REX_VITA_BUILD)
  include("$ENV{VITASDK}/share/vita.cmake" REQUIRED)
  # newlib lacks C23 roundeven/roundevenf (used by simde).
  target_sources(ppc_tests_vita PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../common/vita_math_compat.c)
  target_link_libraries(ppc_tests_vita PRIVATE
    SceDisplay_stub SceCtrl_stub SceSysmem_stub SceIofilemgr_stub
    SceLibKernel_stub SceKernelThreadMgr_stub SceProcessmgr_stub pthread)
  vita_create_self(eboot.bin ppc_tests_vita)
  vita_create_vpk(rexglue_ppc_tests.vpk RXGT00001 eboot.bin
    VERSION "01.00"
    NAME "ReXGlue PPC Tests")
else()
  target_compile_options(ppc_tests_vita PRIVATE -msse4.1 -mssse3)
endif()
